Name: AutoAxe
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod helps with chopping trees using an axe, making operations simpler.
[*]Detects hard-to-spot twigs.
[*]Automatically switches to an axe when near chop-able objects.
[*]Includes a safety feature to protect farm trees from accidental chopping.
[/list]
[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Equip your axe.
[*]Approach any object that can be chopped.
[/list][list]
[*]Customize settings for a semi-automatic feel. [color=#6d9eeb][b]Right-click [/b][/color]to mark targets for auto-chopping.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Set targets: Twigs, Any Tree, Stump, Log.
[*]Option to ignore farm trees.
[*]Option to ignore growing trees.
[*]Automatic axe switching can be configured
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29058/29058-1730680274-548072333.gif[/img]
[img]https://images.plurk.com/2lKSO0itkvtCRue7IZHr30.gif[/img]
﻿Right-click to mark objects, adding eligible objects to the axe's chopping targets.
This also serves as a safety mechanism to prevent accidental logging of farm trees.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29058/29058-1730680471-1421676536.gif[/img]
﻿Efficiently chop stumps.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29058/29058-1730680595-306249041.gif[/img]
Detects hard-to-spot twigs.
